en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Al Barqy, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Hisham Bin Salim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> is more Benevolent than for Him<sup>azwj</sup> to Encumber the people what they are not enduring; and Allah<sup>azwj</sup> is Mightier than that there would happen to be in His<sup>azwj</sup> Authority what He<sup>azwj</sup> does not want’.
